diagnostics.message: kubernetes_service_account_v1.zombie_runner_cleanup is created in the namespace named by var.controller_config.namespace, which is provisioned by module.controller's kubernetes_namespace.controller_namespace resource. The service account only references the variable value, not that resource, so Terraform has no ordering guarantee and can try to create the ServiceAccount before the namespace exists. It should be ordered after the namespace (e.g. depends_on = [module.controller]).

kubernetes_role_v1.zombie_runner_cleanup is a namespaced Role created in var.controller_config.namespace, which is provisioned by module.controller's kubernetes_namespace.controller_namespace. The Role references only the variable string and nothing in module.controller, so there is no ordering guarantee that the namespace exists before the Role is created. It should depend on the namespace resource (e.g. depends_on = [module.controller]).

aws_eks_pod_identity_association.eks_pod_identity binds the runner IAM role to the service account named by var.service_account, but it only references the variable string, not the kubernetes_service_account_v1.runner_sa resource that actually creates that service account. This leaves the association and the service account with no ordering/consistency link. Wire the association's service_account to the runner_sa resource so the dependency is inferred.
